newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Sen. Nickles sees tax pieces in top ten bills.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sen. Nickles sees tax pieces in top ten bills.

text.p: Assistant Senate Majority Leader Don Nickles said Wednesday a tax component for families would likely be in the Republicans' first 10 bills they plan to introduce later this month.
"I think you'll see a tax component as one or more of the bills in our top 10, but we're going to work on that Thursday and Friday," he told reporters after a joint House-Senate leadership meeting.
Senate Republicans are holding a retreat at the end of this week to firm up their legislative agenda.

"It's my hope and desire that you'll see a constitutional amendment to balance the budget probably be at the top of the list and you'll see some tax relief for American families and to stimulate the economy also on that list," Nickles said.

"My guess is you'll see a tax component for families, and I'd like to see something (on a) tax component for helping the economy in our top ten list ... I wouldn't be so bold as to try to define it now," he said.
Nickles also said he hoped capital gains tax relief and some inheritance tax relief for family owned operations would be in the package.
